lines.en: I come with my eyes shut
My feet land without a sound

lines.zh: 我走过的地方声音都停了
lines.en: Sound dies where I pass
I walk without looking
My head hangs a little
I step on, neither fast nor slow
My hands hang still at my sides

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，脚步压得很低
lines.en: I walk along the wall with my steps pressed low

lines.zh: 我脚尖碰到碎石，停了一下
lines.en: My toe knocks a pebble; I pause
The wind stops as I come near
I keep coming your way
I stand with my eyes closed

lines.zh: 胸口几乎不动，气从牙缝漏
lines.en: My chest hardly moves; air hisses through my teeth
I do not mean to open them

lines.zh: 一边耳朵自己转了过去
lines.en: One ear turns by itself
I stand still, yet I know you are there
One corner of my mouth lifts
I have no need to look at all
My fingers tap slowly

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，耳朵对着你的方向
lines.en: Eyes shut, my ear points toward you
I fold my hands in front
I hold still as a statue
I face you with eyes closed
Can you see my eyelids

lines.zh: 我不用睁眼也知道你在哪
lines.en: I know where you are without looking
You have stopped before me
You stand in front of my face
I have not opened them
Your hand keeps moving
There is no expression on my face
Your breath lands on my face
My eyelids twitch once

lines.zh: 你听得到我呼吸的节奏
lines.en: You can hear my breathing
I have not blinked once
You have looked away
My upper body tips once
I give half a step and stop
My fingers shake
That was no light blow
I never once opened my eyes
I turn my face by degrees
I did not cry out
I am still on my feet
That truly hurt
You hold it up before my face
Nor do I need to

lines.zh: 这东西在我这儿没有意义
lines.en: This means nothing to me
I brush it away with a hand
That smell does not interest me
I am not listening to you
It is right against my face
Set it down and leave
You crash into me
I do not even open my eyes
You are jarred half a step back
I hold my ground
You cannot catch my collar

lines.zh: 我顺着你的力气转了半圈
lines.en: I turn half around with your push
I keep a mark of that hit
I still have not opened them
I do not even turn my head
You get back and steady yourself

lines.zh: 我闭着眼也能感觉到你
lines.en: I can feel you even with eyes shut

lines.zh: 我在这条路上一个人走
lines.en: I walk this road alone
Do not stand so close
I shake my head slowly
I give no answer at all
I go on standing there
I shake my head and walk on
I do not mean to say anything
I cannot see what it is
I feel its edge with my fingers
It feels cold
I put it in my pocket
I squeeze it, it is hard
I put it back
I lift it to my ear
I listen, then set it down
You are standing there
My head is square to you
I have placed you by sound
I raise a hand your way
Hiding will not help you
I can reach you with my eyes shut
You carry a living warmth
I have begun to shift forward
It has gone very quiet here
You are square before me
My ear snaps up and my toes leave the floor
You are not getting away
I have taken my step
I stay turned to you
You moved a step just now
I start toward you
I still have not opened my eyes
You have backed to the left
I turn with your footsteps
I can hear you panting
I stop and hold still
I close the gap step by step
My hand is nearly on you
You cannot see what I am thinking
I tip my head and listen
You stepped on a twig
I angle that way
There is no road left behind you
I close one more step
My breathing is at your ear
You are counting your own heartbeats
I turn with your footsteps
You have not backed off again
I lower my hand slowly
My face is aimed straight at yours
I thrust a hand out
I take hold of your lapel

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挥了一下
lines.en: I swing toward you
I clamp your wrist
I strike true with my eyes shut
You give half a step, I follow
I press your shoulder down
I come at you again
You cover your head and dodge aside
My hand is at your face
My eyes are still shut
You are spun half around
I hold your wrist tight
I turn aside from your hand
Everything goes quiet first
I stand there with eyes shut

lines.zh: 你听见的是很轻的脚步
lines.en: What you hear are light steps
A weight joins the air

lines.zh: 我停下的时候没有声音
lines.en: My stopping makes no sound
The wind draws back from here
My whole body holds still
My shadow reaches the ground first

lines.zh: 光线在我周围暗了一档
lines.en: The light dims a notch around me

lines.zh: 你听到一声很轻的呼吸
lines.en: You hear one soft breath

lines.zh: 我站在离你不远的地方
lines.en: I stand not far from you
I have not opened my eyes

lines.zh: 我垂着手，停在离你两步处
lines.en: Hands hanging, I stop two steps from you
My mouth moves at the corner
The sounds behind you stop
I turn my face to you slowly
This place is very quiet now
I am here, no need to look back
Fire brushes my face and I do not flinch

lines.zh: 我落地时膝盖沉了一下
lines.en: My knees dip as I land

lines.zh: 水淹上来，我仍旧闭着眼
lines.en: Water rises and my eyes stay shut
An arrow grazes my cheek
Magic dances on my eyelids

lines.zh: 这具身子很久没进东西了
lines.en: This body has taken nothing in ages
Lightning passes through all of me
I fall, and my eyes stay closed
